meta.description: Two social perception experiments on American English numerals. Precision (approximate *about fifty minutes*, underspecified *fifty minutes*, precise *forty-nine minutes*) was crossed with Scenario (For-the-record, Persuasive, Stranger, Bonding). Participants rated the speaker on ten seven-point scales, which a principal component analysis reduced to Status, Solidarity and anti-Solidarity composite scores. Experiment 1 recruited on Amazon Mechanical Turk with six written items per participant; Experiment 2 showed one illustrated item per participant.
